images.name: W1
images.prompt: Full-body photo of the Korean woman whose face is shown in the reference photo (keep exactly the same face: almond eyes, straight nose, full natural lips, calm chic expression, same long straight black hair with a center part falling past the shoulders), slender build, 168cm tall, standing relaxed with weight on one leg, wearing a camel wool long coat, cream cable knit sweater, black wide slacks and black loafers. Shot in our own moody fitting atelier set: a dark warm charcoal-brown textured limewash plaster wall behind the model, a tall slim arched floor mirror leaning against the wall on one side, a single cognac leather lounge chair and a tall potted olive tree on the other side, polished dark concrete floor with a low round travertine stone plinth near the wall. No curtains, no fabric floor lamps, no clothes racks, no rugs. Overall mood slightly dark and warm, cinematic; a soft focused key light from the front lights the model and the clothes clearly so the outfit stands out with crisp fabric texture and true colors, while the room around stays dimmer, a faint warm glow on the wall behind. Camera at chest height a few meters away, 35mm lens, full body head to toe visible with some space above the head. Real photograph, natural skin texture, not CGI, no text, no logos, no brand marks
